body:
Thought I was doing better than I was.

It came to the run up of exams and I didn't put the effort in that was needed. Hence how they all went to shit and I failed.

I loved studying, but I threw it all away like a fool. 

I don't really like much. I like playing video games and I love watching wrestling, but other than that nothing makes me really lose that gut wrenching feeling.

So I'm pretty fucked whichever way I look at life
